title: LLMs as survey respondents: Comparison to simple semantic baselines
abstract: arXiv:2610.29645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been explored as surrogates for human survey respondents. A more promising application is data augmentation, where LLMs predict new responses from partial human data. However, the semantic similarity between questionnaire items is a known source of correlation between answers. It is thus unclear whether LLMs actually infer meaningful relationships between question-response pairs, or use surface-level comparison between questions as a heuristic. To assess this, we evaluated how three LLMs can predict responses to held-out items in two surveys measuring attitudes toward automated or light-electric vehicles, based on varying proportions of known responses. Performance was compared to two baselines, where new responses were derived by maximizing embedding-similarity to a prior response. translated_title: 大语言模型作为调查问卷受访者：与简单语义基线的比较
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被探索作为人类调查问卷受访者的替代品。一个更有前景的应用是数据增强，即LLM根据部分人类数据预测新的回答。然而，问卷题目之间的语义相似性是答案之间相关性的一个已知来源。因此，尚不清楚LLM究竟是真正推断出问题与回答对之间的有意义关系，还是仅仅利用题目间的表层比较作为启发式方法。为了评估这一点，我们测试了三个LLM在两项分别测量对自动驾驶汽车或轻型电动汽车态度的调查中，基于不同比例的已知回答来预测留出题项回答的能力。实验将LLM的表现与两个基线进行了比较，这些基线通过最大化与已有回答的嵌入相似性来生成新回答。结果表明，尽管LLM在大多数情况下对人类回答的预测优于基线，但随着已知回答比例的降低，其性能持续下降。
tldr: 研究发现LLM在根据部分人类回答预测问卷新回答时通常优于基于嵌入相似性的简单语义基线，但其优势随已知回答比例的降低而减弱，表明其可能依赖题目间的表层语义相似性作为启发式方法。
en_tdlr: LLMs generally outperform simple embedding-similarity baselines in predicting held-out survey responses from partial human data, but their advantage consistently declines as the share of known responses decreases, suggesting reliance on surface-level semantic similarity between questions as a heuristic.
